Automated hermes-sweeper review: this is covered on current main.

- `plugins/image_gen/openai/__init__.py:3` exposes OpenAI `gpt-image-2` as a bundled image generation backend, with low/medium/high tiers selected through `image_gen` config.
- `plugins/image_gen/openai/__init__.py:216` shows the provider actually calls `client.images.generate()` with `model: "gpt-image-2"`.
- `tools/image_generation_tool.py:222` also includes `fal-ai/gpt-image-2` in the built-in FAL-backed image model catalog.
- For custom APIs, `website/docs/developer-guide/image-gen-provider-plugin.md:9` and `:244` document the image_gen provider plugin path, including overriding a bundled backend to point at a private proxy/custom backend.

This implementation is present in current main and is contained in release `v2026.5.16` via `413990c94537e9c9da973bb21a6afcd332400b91`.
